print_csv_format: print evaluation results in CSV format for easy spreadsheet copy-pasting
verify_results: verify evaluation results against expected thresholds and exit on failure
flatten_results_dict: flatten a hierarchical results dictionary into a single-level key-slash-value dict
test_print_csv_format: test the print_csv_format function with sample evaluation metrics
test_verify_results: test the verify_results function with expected and actual evaluation results
